Hi Maya / Connor — quick technical notes to address your latency and SAML questions: 

Embeddings + re-ranker (100 qps target):
- Example two-stage: (1) FAISS ANN index for candidate recall (64-d / 768-d vectors depending on model), (2) lightweight transformer reranker that scores top-K (K=20).
- Typical p95 latencies we see: ANN recall ~8-15ms, re-ranker inference (quantized) ~20-40ms on A10 / 40ms-80ms on smaller GPUs. End-to-end p95 ~35-120ms depending on batch sizing and KV cache hit-rate.
- Cost note: batching and prefix caching reduces per-query GPU time; we'll include guidance per your expected shard size.

Auth / SSO / KMS:
- SAML (Okta) supported via our IdP integration; we can also expose OIDC for developer tokens. For customer-managed keys, we support KMS + HSM-backed envelopes (bring-your-own KMS).
- Token scoping: per-route scopes + short-lived ephemeral tokens for server-to-server flows; we can show a sample policy for your data-protection team.

SDK / routing / structured output:
- SDKs (Node/Python) include streaming, structured-output helpers (tool-calling wrappers) and built-in retry/backoff.
- Routing options: region-based routing + cost-tier fallback to quantized model variants; we can provide JSON routing policies you can push to our control plane.

I will prepare the SDK quickstart with a small re-ranker example and a sample routing JSON. Olga — will share by Tue 4/20 as discussed. Soojin — can you add the KMS/SSO notes to the auth doc?
